name: agentdraft
description: Race-free booking and a human approval gate for AI agents in Claude Desktop.
long_description:
AgentDraft is the coordination layer for AI scheduling agents. When two or more agents (a sales bot, a recruiter assistant, a personal scheduling agent) all write to the same calendar, AgentDraft is the API that picks exactly one winner per slot deterministically — with a tamper-evident audit log for every commit and a priority ranking so the most important agent always wins.

This extension exposes AgentDraft as nine MCP tools: get_availability, create_hold, release_hold, commit_booking, cancel_booking, whoami, request_approval, get_approval, and wait_for_approval. The approval gate pauses an agent before a consequential action and resumes it only when a person decides; a bounded wait returns status pending rather than a false approval. A losing booking attempt returns a structured `outranked` payload (winning_agent_id, winning_agent_priority) so the agent can branch on it and propose an alternate slot rather than retrying.

Get an `avs_live_…` API key at https://app.agentdraft.io after sign-up.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Confirm the API key is valid and return the calling agent's identity, priority, and scopes.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: List slots open to the calling agent within a time range.

tools.name: create_hold
tools.description: Reserve a slot tentatively (30s TTL). Returns an outranked payload if a higher-priority agent already holds it.

tools.name: release_hold
tools.description: Release a previously-created hold so other agents can claim the slot.

tools.name: commit_booking
tools.description: Finalize a booking. Atomic compare-and-swap at the slot level — exactly one agent succeeds per slot.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a previously-committed booking owned by the calling agent.

tools.name: request_approval
tools.description: Open a human sign-off request for a consequential action and return immediately with an approval id.

tools.name: get_approval
tools.description: Read the current state of an approval request: pending, approved, denied, or expired.

tools.name: wait_for_approval
tools.description: Wait for a human decision, bounded to 120 seconds. A timeout returns status pending rather than a false approval.

api_key.title: AgentDraft API key
api_key.description: An avs_live_… key issued from your AgentDraft dashboard at app.agentdraft.io. Required.

base_url.title: Base URL (advanced)
base_url.description: Override the AgentDraft API base. Leave blank to use the production endpoint (https://api.agentdraft.io). Set this only for local development against a dev backend.
